releases.body:
* v2 quiz dialogs reach v1 UI parity: the popup is sized from the shared `popupSize` helper so it lands inside the host's fixed dialog frame instead of being clipped at the bottom, long option lists and note boxes auto-scroll to stay visible, and Enter in the batch review advances to the next question.
* The pinned scroll cue now sits **outside** the scroll region, as its own row under the header, so it can never scroll away from the explanation it describes. It takes a colour per case — green for content both above and below, yellow for below only, purple for above only — and hides when there is nothing to scroll.
* The review opens focused on the scroll view, so `j`/`k`/`d`/`u` scroll straight after answering; `Tab` moves into the optional *why* box. The *why* text stays separate from the classifier note and is preserved through the response, the injected prompt and `md_log`.
* v2 renders question, details and explanation through `<markdown>` with v1's `syntaxStyle` theme, so headings, bold, italics and lists render properly instead of collapsing into one pre-wrapped text blob.
* Classification falls back to the runtime default agent when no `classify` agent exists. Availability is resolved from the runtime agent registry, the strict prompt is unchanged, and registry/auth/quota/model errors surface as real failures instead of being mistaken for a missing agent. The v2 adapter also creates a parent-linked child session and applies agent/model selection via `session.switchAgent`/`session.switchModel`.
* Tests: new `plugins/classify-agent.test.ts` (15 watcher-level cases across v1 and v2) and `plugins/v2-interactions.test.tsx` (7 OpenTUI runtime cases); `popup-fit` gains frame-containment, cue-pinning, cue-colour and markdown coverage. `test` runs `bun test` instead of a placeholder.
